journey.name: TH-02 Switching to dark mode keeps a half-filled form
journey.description:
A theme change is a configuration change like a rotation, and it recreates the activity the same way - but it is the one every user actually performs, usually from the notification shade, and the suite has never covered it. NFR-06 says configuration change, not rotation; LC-01 to LC-03 only ever rotate.
It is also the cheapest way to notice a theme that is applied at composition rather than read from the configuration: a form that comes back light on a dark device has kept its state and lost its theme, which no rotation would reveal.
Reset the device afterwards with `adb shell cmd uimode night no` if it started in light mode.
Preconditions: adb shell cmd uimode night no adb shell am force-stop com.rounds.test.to_dolist adb shell am start -n com.rounds.test.to_dolist/.MainActivity --es qa_failure_rate 0.0

actions.action: Tap the element with the content description "Add task"
Type "Half a thought in daylight" into the "Title" field
Type "Written before the lights went out" into the "Notes (optional)" field
Using adb, switch the device to dark mode with `cmd uimode night yes`
Verify from a screenshot that the editor is now rendered on a dark background
Verify that the title "New task" is on screen
Verify that the "Title" field still contains "Half a thought in daylight"
Verify that the "Notes (optional)" field still contains "Written before the lights went out"
Verify that the "High" priority chip is still selected
Using adb, switch the device back to light mode with `cmd uimode night no`
Verify that the "Title" field still contains "Half a thought in daylight"
Verify that the "High" priority chip is still selected
